content:
[V] low | whole window | Window has no app chrome/titlebar context, content is flush against top-left edge with minimal margin.
[L] high | right two-thirds of screen | Entire right and lower area (x>530) is completely empty; content occupies only left ~35% of a 1440-wide window.
[C] high | right of alerts panel | Massive dead zone beside the alert list with no secondary panel, graph, or detail view to balance composition.
[S] med | alerts list rows | "Open" labels are not column-aligned; each Open floats at a different x-position trailing variable-width text.
[S] low | alerts list rows | Vertical gaps between alert rows (~45px) are much larger than needed, creating a stretched, airy list inconsistent with dense SLA list.
[S] med | SLA card | "open →" links sit close under the pill above but with inconsistent larger gap before next pill, giving uneven rhythm.
[H] low | alerts card | Count string "6 radar alert(s)" exposes raw debug-style "(s)" formatting instead of proper pluralization.
[H] low | tabs row | Active tab "Alerts" is near-black while inactive tabs are very low-contrast gray, but all share same size so hierarchy relies only on faint color.
[C] med | header buttons | Three action buttons (Detect gaps now / Reload clusters / Cluster now) crowd the far top-right corner far from the content they act upon.
[L] med | SLA card bottom | "open →" under #5040 pill sits very close to the card's bottom edge, near-clipping.
[S] low | SLA card | SLA pills have varying widths creating ragged left-aligned shapes with no consistent text wrapping or fixed-width rhythm.
[C] med | SLA card | SLA card is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, implying more content below with no scroll affordance visible.

TOTAL 12
